derived.why: the scene camera stands 0.53 m behind the shop's wall (issue #4 part A); the EYE goes 1.5 m along its view, level (pitch 0, roll 0), with its yaw

notes.backface_allowed: the set walls and wall panels were built to be seen from outside the room; from inside they show back-faces (13.4 % of the sphere). Accepted as the scene is, not edited. Any other object's back-faces count against max_backface_fraction_other only on closed meshes (flipped normals, or the head inside); open meshes (planes, shelves without backs) are reported. The pattern was 'wall_panels', which matched nothing (Chat's spec error, #4 part B)
notes.missing_images: the images used by rendered objects whose files are missing (Cycles renders them magenta): generic_scratches.png on 30 floor panels, guilder_ornament.png on the cash register's price tags (#4 part B, Code). The triage's other 5 missing images are used by no rendered object: the four agent_face_* only by the unused material agent_skin, Dirt_Patch_512.png by nothing. Corrected from the triage's 7 (Chat's spec error)
